title: elaphoglossum chartaceum
intro: Elaphoglossum chartaceum, commonly known as the paper fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of E. chartaceum include its potential anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is believed to contain compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
